name: agentguard
description: Stops a runaway burst of sub-agents until you allow it and shows where your Claude Code or Codex tokens went. Runs on your machine.

license_key.title: AgentGuard license key
license_key.description: Only for a paid plan (Solo or Team). Leave empty for Free, which needs no key. Stored in your system credential store and sent only to agentguard.run to check the license.

quick_models.title: Extra model buttons
quick_models.description: Comma list of up to nine model ids to add to the AgentGuard panel. Buttons fill a model command; you press Enter to switch the main chat. Fable, Opus, Sonnet and Haiku 5.5 are always listed. Helper agents keep the existing helper_models policy.

status_fields.title: Optional status line fields
status_fields.description: Comma list: pace estimates time until a plan limit; cost shows session cost at API list prices; cache shows large prefix rewrite tokens and API list cost; spend shows local daily policy spend and its cap. Leave empty for the default line.
